title: Pops and Willie Foster, and Kid Ory's band
summary: The Fosters, and a trombone player with a brass band.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Do you remember Pops Foster and Willie Foster? Pops Foster's George Foster, he played the bass?

We used to call him Troste. We used to go, bands used to have were hoistels them days at people's house and they'd invite you. You know, we had plenty of that ourselves. And this fella, we went to a lot of things. I don't know what band he had here. Did he die in California? Did he die in California? Yeah, Aura. Yeah, Aura had a band here. Used to call it Aura's Band, Aura's Brass Band. He was a trombone player. Well, they had a couple of brothers to play music. They come from right up around, somewhere around Coliseum Street, all around up in there, Coliseum and Cades. It's just been so long, I forgot. What about Piku?
